info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Investment Portfolio Statements-v2-spec
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Statements Retrieval API allows users to access detailed investment portfolio statements. This API provides investors and financial advisors with the essential data needed to review performance, manage assets, and make informed decisions. Typical consumers include financial institutions, investment managers, and clients seeking transparency in their portfolios. By enabling quick access to past and current statements, this API supports efficient investment management and analysis.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of portfolio statements.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to access a detailed list of statements related to their investment portfolio. It provides insights into transaction history, account balances, and performance metrics, helping users make informed financial decisions.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving portfolio statements. It should contain the necessary parameters to filter or specify which statements to retrieve.
